newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 5.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 5.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on November 5, a central bank official said on Monday.
The volume of three-month T-bills was set at 50 million hryvnias, but the central bank has not set issue volumes for the remaining paper, an economist at the bank, Inna Boshko, said.
At the last three-month T-bill sale on October 29, the bank sold 1.67 million hryvnias of paper, with an average annualised yield of 30.19 percent. The average price was 93.00 hryvnias.
The bank sold 3.58 million hryvnias worth of six-month T-bills on October 31, with an average annualised yield of 49.39 percent and an average price of 80.24 hryvnias.
Nine-month discount T-bills sold at an average price of 69.70 hryvnias on October 31 at an auction of 3.23 million hryvnias worth of paper with average yields of 58.12 percent.
At the last auction of 12-month discount T-bills on October 31, the bank sold 158,000 hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 60.94 percent. The average price was 62.20 hryvnias.
